propositions: Per-unit _convert invocation resolves _pandoc_timeout() redundantly, triggering repo_root discovery 883 times across 884 conversions when a single resolution at render-pass entry point suffices.
Current 884-unit production trace launches 1,770 Popen calls (884 Pandoc + 886 git rev-parse) versus optimal 887 (884 Pandoc + 3 cold-root probes).
Timeout and git-root resolution are not part of any render assertion contract and OSS consensus (Django, Black, pytest) resolves loop/session-invariant configuration once before repeated work.

Hoisting _pandoc_timeout() to render_markdown_to_wiki and threading it via optional parameters to _render_unit and _convert preserves all 884 real Pandoc calls, byte-exact outputs, per-unit fallback, timeout configurability, and process-group reap behavior.

Held-out oracle confirmed one timeout resolution per three-unit render pass (RED at 3, GREEN at 1, defect-seed RED at 4, restoration GREEN); focused test suite (90 passed) and subprocess count reduction (883 redundant processes eliminated) validate fix without material wall-clock gain on quiet hosts.
